items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1961-05-11
items.q: Louis Armstrong is the only one that happened to mention in his biography of George Moret.

ctx.x: Yes, I just want to say that, that Louis Armstrong is the only one that happened to mention in his biography of George Moret.
And last summer in New Orleans, they had a series of three TV interviews. And he talked again about hearing old man Moret. He always calls him in the parades. That's right. And how good he was.
